source_of_truth: prior V3/V4 immutable; original SRT/private archive never committed
one_turn_contract: Retrieve the exact private original SRT when accessible, hash raw bytes and map every material cue
Reconcile all V3 claim IDs with approved, qualified, hypothetical, contradicted or blocked statuses
Independently read relevant current primary sources, effective dates and exceptions; document material contradictions
Compute and independently verify all material numbers with semantic/legal suitability and counterfactuals; do not substitute pure arithmetic for economics
Use a common baseline and NO_CHANGE comparator, include costs, tax, liquidity, downside and change-of-decision conditions
Check cross-video contradictions and update only nonpersonal V5 derivatives; block inherited CONTRADICTED claims
Perform feasible follow-up evidence work in the SAME research turn; label third-party/private truly inaccessible evidence with proof category and exact decision block
Finish report, atomic Git commit, readback and CI for that exact commit; state outcome not action permission

module_release_levels.DECISION_MODULE_READY_L2: All material video-claim evidence and numeric calculations scoped; scenario-ready generic advice logic, NOT client recommendation
module_release_levels.DECISION_MODULE_LIMITED_L2: Generic conditional logic only; external/empirical gaps explicitly block affected actions
module_release_levels.EVIDENCE_BLOCKED: No material decision rule approved; inability to verify primary source or contradiction prevents hypothetical guidance

test_input: No numerical private user data; models use synthetic assumptions or public independently sourced data only
